 Job Scan Home / GST / CBIC Clarifies GST Export Refund Rules, Set-Off of Export Receivables Against Import Payables GST Law Report CBIC Clarifies GST Export Refund Rules, Set-Off of Export Receivables Against Import Payables
 CBIC has clarified that export payments received through permitted rupee accounts and RBI-approved set-off arrangements can satisfy GST export conditions.
 By  Kavi Priya · 29 Oct 2026, 10:19 am IST 2′ read Save Get the day's tax rulings in your inbox 
 Email address Subscribe × Read the Order Subscribers only The Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) issued a circular dated October 26, 2026 clarifying the Goods and Services Tax (GST) treatment of export payments received through Special Non-Resident Rupee (SNRR) accounts, Nostro accounts and the set-off of export receivables against import payables.
 The Central Board clarified that payments received for export of services in convertible foreign exchange or through repatriable Indian Rupee (INR) accounts including SNRR and INR Nostro accounts, satisfy the payment condition under Section 2(6)(iv) of the Integrated Goods and Services Tax (IGST) Act, 2017.
